SUMMARY:
 This image is a bubble chart that illustrates the relationship between fertilizer usage, crop yield, and farm size across several Indian states for the year 2011. The chart’s title, displayed prominently at the top, reads "Fertilizer Usage, Crop Yield, and Farm Size Across Indian States (2011)." The x-axis represents fertilizer usage measured in kilograms per hectare, ranging from approximately 80 to 260 kg/hectare. The y-axis denotes crop yield, measured in tons per hectare, spanning from 2 to 5.5 tons/hectare.

Each bubble in the chart corresponds to a specific district within a state, with the size of the bubble indicating the farm size in hectares—the larger the bubble, the larger the farm size. The bubbles are color-coded by state, with a legend at the top of the chart identifying the states: Andhra Pradesh, Gujarat, West Bengal, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, and Odisha.

From the visual data, it is apparent that regions with higher fertilizer usage, such as those around 200-240 kg/hectare, tend to have higher crop yields, generally between 4.5 and 5.2 tons/hectare. For instance, Maharashtra and Tamil Nadu show some of the highest crop yields (around 5 tons/hectare) with corresponding high fertilizer usage. Conversely, states like Bihar and Rajasthan, which have lower fertilizer usage (around 85-120 kg/hectare), exhibit lower crop yields (approximately 2.3 to 3 tons/hectare). The varying sizes of the bubbles indicate differences in farm sizes, with some of the largest farms appearing in states like Maharashtra and Tamil Nadu. This chart effectively conveys how fertilizer usage correlates with crop productivity and highlights the differences in farm sizes across various districts and states.

import runpy
original = runpy.run_path("chart.py")
old_fig = original["fig"]
full = old_fig.full_figure_for_development(warn=False)
print("Original axis ranges:", full.layout.xaxis.range, full.layout.yaxis.range)
source = Path("chart.py").read_text()
source = source.replace(
    "df = pd.DataFrame(data)",
    """original_df = pd.DataFrame(data)
df = pd.read_csv('table.csv').merge(
    original_df, on=list(pd.read_csv('table.csv').columns), how='left',
    validate='one_to_one'
)
state_colors = dict(zip(original_df['State'].unique(), px.colors.qualitative.Set3))"""
)
source = source.replace("'Crop Yield (tons/hectare)': 'Farm Size (hectares)'",
                        "'Crop Yield (tons/hectare)': 'Crop Yield (tons/hectare)'")
source = source.replace("color_discrete_sequence=px.colors.qualitative.Set3",
                        "color_discrete_map=state_colors")
source = source.replace("b=50, t=50", "b=50, t=110")
source = source.replace("fig.write_image('output.png')",
    f"""fig.update_layout(title_y=0.98)
fig.update_xaxes(range={list(full.layout.xaxis.range)!r})
fig.update_yaxes(range={list(full.layout.yaxis.range)!r})
fig.write_image('output.png')""")
Path("chart.py").write_text(source)
result = runpy.run_path("chart.py")
fig = result["fig"]
print("Axis labels:", fig.layout.xaxis.title.text, fig.layout.yaxis.title.text)
print("Plotted states and counts:", [(t.name, len(t.x), t.marker.color) for t in fig.data])
print("Total points:", sum(len(t.x) for t in fig.data))

source = Path("chart.py").read_text()
original_colors = {t.name: t.marker.color for t in old_fig.data}
source = source.replace(
    "state_colors = dict(zip(original_df['State'].unique(), px.colors.qualitative.Set3))",
    f"state_colors = {original_colors!r}"
)
Path("chart.py").write_text(source)
result = runpy.run_path("chart.py")
fig = result["fig"]
table = pd.read_csv("table.csv")
for trace in fig.data:
    expected = table[table["State"] == trace.name]
    assert list(trace.x) == expected["Fertilizer Usage (kg/hectare)"].tolist()
    assert list(trace.y) == expected["Crop Yield (tons/hectare)"].tolist()
    assert list(trace.marker.size) == expected["Farm Size (hectares)"].tolist()
    assert trace.marker.color == original_colors[trace.name]
assert sum(len(t.x) for t in fig.data) == len(table)
assert fig.layout.yaxis.title.text == "Crop Yield (tons/hectare)"
assert fig.layout.title.text == old_fig.layout.title.text
print("Verified all 13 points, bubble sizes, original state colors, axis labels, and unchanged title.")
print("Axis ranges:", fig.layout.xaxis.range, fig.layout.yaxis.range)
